name: Question 12
problem:
Consider the vector subspace $H=\text{Span}{[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 4 \\ -4\end{aligned}]}.$ Which of the following vectors belong to ${H}^{⊥}?$

$$
{v}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -5 \\ -4\end{aligned}],\,{v}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 4 \\ -3\end{aligned}],\,{v}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1 \\ 4\end{aligned}]
$$
worked_solution:
Let  $h=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 4 \\ -4\end{aligned}].$ A vector  $v$ belongs to ${H}^{⊥}$ if $v$ is orthogonal to $h.$ So, we have to find the products ${v}_{i}\cdot h$ for $i=1,2,3.$   

- For ${v}_{1}$, we have the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}{v}_{1}\cdot h & =4\cdot 1+(-5)\cdot 4+(-4)\cdot (-4)=0 & ✓\end{aligned}
$$

 
So, ${v}_{1}\in {H}^{⊥}.$

- For ${v}_{2}$, we have the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}{v}_{2}\cdot h & =2\cdot 1+4\cdot 4+(-3)\cdot (-4)=30\ne 0 & \times \end{aligned}
$$

 
So, ${v}_{2}\notin {H}^{⊥}.$

- For ${v}_{3}$, we have the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}{v}_{3}\cdot h & =1\cdot 1+(-1)\cdot 4+4\cdot (-4)=-19\ne 0 & \times \end{aligned}
$$

So, ${v}_{3}\notin {H}^{⊥}.$

Therefore, the correct answer is "${v}_{1}$  only".

Question 12
?

Consider the vector subspace H=Span{[14−4]}. Which of the following vectors belong to H⊥? v1=[4−5−4],v2=[24−3],v3=[1−14]

a
v1 and v3 only
b
v2 and v3 only
c
v1 and v2 only
d
v3 only
e
v1 only
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

Let h=[14−4]. A vector v belongs to H⊥ if v is orthogonal to h. So, we have to find the products vi⋅h for i=1,2,3.

  • For v1, we have the following: v1⋅h=4⋅1+(−5)⋅4+(−4)⋅(−4)=0✓ So, v1∈H⊥.

  • For v2, we have the following: v2⋅h=2⋅1+4⋅4+(−3)⋅(−4)=30≠0× So, v2∉H⊥.

  • For v3, we have the following: v3⋅h=1⋅1+(−1)⋅4+4⋅(−4)=−19≠0× So, v3∉H⊥.

Therefore, the correct answer is "v1 only".
